description: Process (BPT) EDITED and an activity DELETED, over job:process-human-traditional (which only created). Editing: it changes the Detail expression of the process and the conditions of the human activity Review (DueDate, AllowSkip, Instructions) and adds the automatic activity NotifyOwner (with its own flow that calls Contacts_Cleanup) between Review and End, cutting the connector that already existed. Deleting: Review has a real consumer (the connector that comes from the Start; the usages shows it), so the delete only passes after removing that consumer - and the process ends up Start -> NotifyOwner -> End, valid. The refusal of the delete with a consumer is attached to the report (it aborts the job, so it does not fit here).
